title: Candon cops hold school safety drills on shooting incidents

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police personnel conducted safety drills on active attacks and shooting incidents in four schools in Candon City to strengthen emergency preparedness among teachers and pupils. The activities were carried out by personnel of the Candon City Police Station (CPS) under the supervision of its officer-in-charge, Police Lt. Col. Zaldy C. Fuentes. The drills were held at Oaig Daya Elementary School, Saint Cecilia Early Learning Center Inc., Parioc Elementary School and San Andres Adventist Elementary School, Candon CPS said in a report on Friday, Nov. 13.
